business_problem: Price Forbes needed a data model for specialty-insurance products that avoided impossible SQL trade-offs, supported quote-and-bind workflows, and outperformed its earlier Cosmos DB proof of concept.
solution_summary: Price Forbes adopted MongoDB Atlas to build Placement Hub and its quote-and-bind insurance platform around a document model that could handle wildly different specialty-risk products without the impossible trade-offs of MySQL table design. Products ranging from homes to satellites are stored as JSON-like documents in a single collection, then deserialized into the right application class when brokers retrieve them. After an initial proof of concept on Cosmos DB's MongoDB API exposed document-size and aggregation limits, MongoDB Atlas more than doubled performance, and MongoDB Professional Services helped the team script a painless remote migration in two days. Atlas also pairs with reactive drivers so Placement Hub can release threads while I/O completes, giving brokers a fast search and workflow platform that reached 90% adoption.

Reactive Atlas drivers let Placement Hub process many concurrent requests while data is also pushed into policy-administration workflows and supporting documentation services.
